supporting_observations.claim: At 13:38:31 UTC, the domain controller recorded a Kerberos service ticket for paul.becker to the WS-DREYES-01$ service, from source IP 10.52.10.23.
At 13:40:48 UTC, WS-DREYES-01 made a proxy CONNECT request to download.windowsupdate.com with a Windows Update Agent user agent; the proxy returned status 502 and recorded a gateway error.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-DREYES-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:20 UTC, covering the reported PowerShell-window time; process creation, command line, and PowerShell activity on the alerted host therefore cannot be verified.
The available proxy and network records do not show whether PowerShell ran or what caused the reported window.
The available evidence does not map source IP 10.52.10.23 to a host.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell ran on WS-DREYES-01 around 13:40 UTC, and, if so, its command line, parent process, user, and actions.
Whether the service ticket for paul.becker preceded the reported activity or represents an authorized remote-admin session to WS-DREYES-01.
Whether the Windows Update request was part of the scheduled workstation patching or was related to the reported PowerShell window.
Whether any scripts, files, credentials, or other data were accessed or changed during the reported activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or collect endpoint EDR, process-creation, PowerShell operational, and script-block logs for WS-DREYES-01 covering 13:30–14:20 UTC.
Review WS-PBECKER-01 activity and relevant remote-session or remote-execution logs, and determine whether source IP 10.52.10.23 belongs to that host.
Check FILE-COP-01 share-access records for access to the approved Patch-Workstations.ps1 path during the window.
Confirm with IT whether paul.becker performed the scheduled patching on WS-DREYES-01 and whether the Windows Update activity was expected.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox.exe launched on WS-DREYES-01 at 13:24:47 UTC, outside the reported activity time. Dropbox is not among the organization's approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services; track separately. (T104-00071, T104-00072)
